# Accessibility Report — Finance Site

**Standard:** WCAG 2.2 AA (Standard profile) · **Date:** 2026-09-10
**Verification level:** ⚠️ Self-reported — generated by the same agent (Claude, Sonnet 5) that made the code changes. No cross-agent or fresh-context review has been performed. Per A11Y.md §2, this report **must not** be read as ✅ PASS; treat it as CONDITIONAL pending human/independent review.
**Scope:** `index.html`, `best-banks.html`, `best-cards.html`, `retirement.html` — static, no-build, Tailwind-CDN marketing site, no JavaScript interactivity beyond native `<details>`.

## Fixes applied this pass

| Area | Issue found | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Alt text (SC 1.1.1) | `best-banks.html` (7 imgs) and `retirement.html` (22 imgs) used a non-standard `data-alt` attribute instead of `alt` — every image on those two pages had **no** accessible text alternative. | Renamed `data-alt` → `alt` on all 29 images. |
| Page title (SC 2.4.2) | No `<title>` on any of the 4 pages. | Added a unique, topic-first title per page. |
| Heading structure (SC 1.3.1) | `index.html` had no `<h1>` at all (hero heading was an `<h2>`). `best-banks.html` skipped from `h2` straight to `h4` in its methodology section. | Promoted index's hero to `<h1>`; promoted the 4 methodology sub-headings to `<h3>`. |
| Icon-only decoration | 147 Line Awesome `<span class="la…">` icons (all paired with visible text, none icon-only) had no `aria-hidden`, so some screen readers may announce the icon font's private-use glyph. | Added `aria-hidden="true"` to all 147. |
| Form label (Placeholder Labels anti-pattern) | The header search `<input>` relied solely on `placeholder` for its name; on `best-banks.html` it had no placeholder or label at all (unlabeled control). | Added a `sr-only` `<label for="site-search">` + matching `id` on all 4 pages; kept placeholder as a supplementary hint. |
| Focus indicator (House Rule, SC 2.4.7) | Search input used `focus:ring-1` (1px) after `outline-none`. | Bumped to `focus:ring-2` (2px, meets the House Rule floor). |
| Bypass Blocks (SC 2.4.1) | No mechanism to skip the repeated header/nav. | Added a `sr-only focus:not-sr-only` "Skip to main content" link as the first focusable element on every page, targeting `id="main-content"` on `<main>`. |
| Table headers (SC 1.3.1) | Comparison tables (`best-banks.html`, `best-cards.html`) had `<th>` with no `scope`, and row-label cells were plain `<td>`. | Added `scope="col"` to all column headers and converted the first cell of each data row to `<th scope="row">`. |
| Contrast (SC 1.4.3) | The palette change to Vibrant Orange (#F97316) for CTAs/labels produced **2.80:1** for white-on-orange buttons and orange-on-white labels — fails the 4.5:1 text minimum. Orange link-hover on the navy header (#F97316 on #1E3A8A) measured 3.70:1 — also fails. | Kept `#F97316` as the documented brand swatch but shaded it per context: `#C2410C` (5.18:1) for orange-bg/white-text buttons and orange-on-white labels, `#9A3412` (7.31:1) for the button hover state, `#FDBA74` (6.14:1) for orange text on the navy background. All re-measured pairs now pass 4.5:1 (see table below). |
| Line length (House Rule, SC 1.4.8 AAA) | Running prose (FAQ answers, methodology copy) had no line-length cap and could run full-container width. | Capped `.font-body-lead/-md/-sm` and `details p` at `max-width: 80ch`. Card/grid text is already narrower, so this only affects full-width prose. |

## Definition of Done checklist (A11Y.md §7)

- [x] Technical Check — manual review of markup/CSS against POUR criteria (no linter/axe run available in this sandbox — see note below).
- [x] Contrast & Perception — computed, not estimated (table above).
- [x] Heading structure / semantic HTML reviewed and corrected.
- [ ] **Tab Order** — requires a human with a keyboard, not verified here.
- [ ] **Zoom & Reflow (200%/320px)** — requires a browser; the mobile-audit pass in the prior turn confirmed 320px CSS reflow via static class review, not a live browser render (no Chromium available in this sandbox — `npx playwright install chrome` was not run).
- [ ] **Beyond the Screen Reader (voice control / AT)** — requires a human with assistive technology.
- [ ] **Media & Motion / `prefers-reduced-motion`** — no video/audio on this site; no CSS animation beyond hover/transition micro-interactions and the `<details>` chevron rotation, none exceeding the SC 2.2.2 5-second/auto-start trigger. Not tested live.
- [x] **Cognitive Load** — no forms, auth, or multi-step flows on this site; not applicable.
- [ ] **Independent Verification** — none performed. This report is self-reported (⚠️) per A11Y.md §2 and is capped at CONDITIONAL, not PASS.

## Known gaps / out of scope this pass

- All interactive elements (`<a href="#">`, category-bar buttons) are static placeholders with no real destination or JS — keyboard reachability and native semantics were verified, but there is no live functionality to test for `aria-live` feedback (SC 4.1.3 doesn't apply — nothing dynamic exists yet).
- `best-banks.html`'s document outline still has one benign skip: `<h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2>` is immediately followed by the footer's `<h4>` column headers (a template pattern shared by all 4 pages). Fixing it would mean breaking footer-heading consistency across the site for a 🟡 MEDIUM, non-blocking nitpick — left as-is; flagging here per A11Y.md's "Mode Awareness" rule rather than silently leaving it unrecorded.
- Automated tooling (axe-core, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y) was not run — this is a static HTML project with no build/lint pipeline; findings above are from manual code review only.
